title: Graded-consistency reingest proxy for tenant-scoped analytics backfills
creator: Maya Patel
description: Implement a lightweight proxy/orchestration layer that accepts reingest/backfill requests for console usage telemetry and routes them into graded consistency lanes (best-effort / causal / strong) based on tenant SLA, cost budget, and data fidelity requirements. The proxy centralizes tenant-scoped rate limiting, global cost throttles, resume/checkpoint tokens, and sampling-based fidelity validation to enable safe incremental replays without overloading downstream stores (event stream, S3, BigQuery).
success_criteria: 1) Reingest proxy can accept and start 200 concurrent tenant-scoped replays without increasing 95th percentile query latency on BigQuery by >5%. 2) Each replay produces idempotent output with resume tokens and checkpointing; reruns from a checkpoint do not duplicate records (verified by hash-based dedupe check). 3) Canary run on 3 internal tenants finishes within expected window and exposes telemetry in console: processed_events/s, bytes_processed, replay_lag_seconds, fidelity_rate. 4) Cost throttles kick-in when projected monthly cost exceeds tenant budget and reduce throughput gracefully.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: API surface and request validation - lightweight HTTP endpoint that accepts tenant_id, target_range, consistency_level, budget_tag, dry_run flag
Phase 2: Checkpointing & resume tokens - integrate with existing resume-token service and persist snapshot pointers to metadata store (Dynamo/Postgres)
Phase 3: Routing & throttles - implement tenant-scoped concurrency and global cost-aware leaky-bucket throttle; expose circuit-breaker for downstream overloads
Phase 4: Fidelity sampling - on ingest, run probabilistic checks comparing replayed rows against golden sample from raw events store; emit fidelity_rate metrics
Phase 5: Observability & alerts - dashboards, per-tenant logs, SLO checks and automatic pause on fidelity regression
Phase 6: Canary + rollout - 3 internal tenants, then gradual ramp to 20 tenants over 2 weeks
tasks: Metadata: schema for replay job with resume_token, window, consistency_level
Checkpoint store migration: add replay_jobs table in console-metadata-db
Throttler: implement tenant leaky-bucket and global cost projection service integration
Worker: replay-worker to read events from archival store (GCS/S3) and emit to ingestion topic with idempotency keys
Fidelity: implement sampling comparator that hashes events and compares against raw-event snapshot
Observability: Grafana dashboard + alert for fidelity_rate < 98%
E2E tests: synthetic tenant replay with validation against golden set
Docs: runbook for paused replays and manual resume

2026-02-28: Rapid spike on cost projection model — integrated a simple per-token cost multiplier derived from model/route profiles; flagged follow-up to refine with Optimize team. (Maya)

2026-03-01: Fidelity sampling prototype validated on small dataset; sampling comparator yields deterministic 1:1 hash; initial fidelity_rate metric added. Observed two edge cases: reordered events and late-arrival duplicates. Added task to extend worker idempotency keys to include event_timestamp. (Jonas)

2026-03-02: Design review with analytics team — approved overall approach, requested additional SLAs for resume token TTL and suggested a configurable backoff policy per tenant. Review notes attached in design doc. (Maya)
notes: This ticket focuses on orchestration and safety mechanisms rather than implementation of heavy compute in workers. Worker changes should be backwards compatible with existing ingestion contracts. Coordinate with Optimize for cost multipliers and with Data Compliance for retention constraints.
